repo:objectstack#4 · os-lizheng · session_012MmDsS4GoHCgYwA2uv3n3C

## 维护者速读(席位终稿 · Head-sha: 486b6feb8f · 2026-11-17T19:47Z)

- 改了什么：技能文档 `data-hooks.md` 里「before 钩子」的事务一格，原来只写「在事务内」，现在讲清楚：钩子经 `ctx.api` 写的数据和外层保存同属一个事务，外层任何一处被拒，钩子的写入一起回滚，不能单独豁免;并列出四种不开事务的例外(调用方自己开了事务、对象不在默认数据源、默认驱动不支持事务如 turso 远程、代码注册的钩子)。另加一条「不要」：before 钩子不要经 `ctx.api` 往别的数据源写业务记录(会被拒，只有审计类账本例外)。配两条评测用例。
- 为什么改:#34412 已经让引擎这样工作(PR #34503),但给 AI 读的技能还写着旧说法，AI 会写出「以为能留下的日志写入」或「跨数据源写」的钩子，运行时才发现被回滚或被拒。
- 风险与回滚：只改技能文本和评测，不改任何运行代码;为不超 token 上限，删了同文件里四处重复表述，席位已逐条核对这些事实在同文件别处仍在。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` 第 62 行(事务一格)与 Best Practices 的 DON'T 一条。
- 两分钟验证：打开该文件第 62 行，读 before 一列：应写明「同一事务、无单钩豁免、四种例外」。
- 需要你做的：批准本 PR(受管面 Tier H，席位不能自批);批准前还欠一次契约审核(L2),已请 l2-review#3。

席位意见：建议批准。四个例外与跨数据源拒绝都由开发对着引擎代码与现有测试逐条核过(MongoDB 一条保留「读自代码、未实测」),删掉的四处重复席位逐条复核仍在原文件。

## 席位核对 · L1 ACCEPT · Head-sha: 486b6feb8f

Card #34504, claim 6958243261, dev report 6959003049. The seat read the diff itself.

| Item | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| Shape | Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #34504`. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. Three files: `data-hooks.md` (+13 −18), the eval file (+20), and a changeset. Governed surface (`skills/**`): Tier H. |
| Premise measured | Holds: line 64 on main said "Within transaction" for `before*` with no exits. Each exit was verified by the dev against the engine code and existing pins. The cross-datasource refusal and the ledger carve-out were also measured with a throwaway probe. MongoDB keeps the "read in code, not measured" hedge, as the governing docs do. |
| Removed text | Four restatements were deleted to fit the token ratchet (15 tokens of headroom; no ceiling moved). The seat re-checked each fact still stands on this head: the declarative fields only on `defineStack` (line 781); `afterFind` covers `findOne` (lines 30–42); per-row `previous` and `input.id` (lines 48, 182); the intro sentence (the page's own section list). |
| Budget | `data-hooks.md` net −5 lines (budget +10), 9992 / 10011 tokens; the whole-package SKILL.md sum unchanged (4728). |
| Gates | 43 of 47 derived families exit 0, among them the token ratchet, skill links and published files. 4 are NOT MEASURED (they need a full build; this diff cannot move them) and are CI-owned. CI is read again before the hand-off. |
| Changeset | `@objectstack/skills` patch: the skill tree ships in that package, so `skip-changeset` does not apply. Read against the diff: the cell, the exits, the DON'T and the two evals match. |
| Out of scope | The `api.transaction` row says "commit on return, rollback on throw" with no condition, while `hooks.mdx` says a nested `transaction()` joins the outer unit: the seat files it. The PostgreSQL no-savepoint note rides #34563. |
| Landing | Governed (Tier H): the maintainer approves; the seat lands after that. Owed first: a contract-review-tier L2 record (governed rules text) and every check green. |
